title.zh: 为马尼拉铁路公司重建并修复其卡巴纳图安支线拨款三百八十万比索的法案，该支线自布拉里德尔市镇（布拉干省）延伸至卡巴纳图安市，资金来源于第1000号共和国法授权发行的债券收益
title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Three Million Eight Hundred Thousand Pesos, Out of the Proceeds of the Bond Issue Authorized by Republic Act Numbered One Thousand, to Finance the Re-Establishment and Rehabilitation by the Manila Railroad Company of its Cabanatuan Branch Extending from the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Bulacan, to the City of Cabanatuan
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Three Million Eight Hundred Thousand Pesos, Out of the Proceeds of the Bond Issue Authorized by Republic Act Numbered One Thousand, to Finance the Re-Establishment and Rehabilitation by the Manila Railroad Company of its Cabanatuan Branch Extending from the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Bulacan, to the City of Cabanatuan
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp khoản tiền ba triệu tám trăm nghìn peso từ nguồn thu từ việc phát hành trái phiếu theo Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 1000 để tài trợ cho việc tái thiết và phục hồi tuyến nhánh Cabanatuan của Công ty Đường sắt Manila kéo dài từ Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Plaridel, Tỉnh Bulacan đến Thành phố Cabanatuan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณสามล้านแปดแสนเปโซจากผลรายได้ของการออกพันธบัตรตามพระราชบัญญัติสาธารณรัฐฉบับที่1000เพื่อสนับสนุนการสร้างใหม่และการฟื้นฟูเส้นทางแยกคาบานาตวนของบริษัทรถไฟมะนิลาซึ่งทอดยาวจากเทศบาลปลาริเดลจังหวัดบูลากันถึงนครคาบานาตวน
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan jumlah tiga juta delapan ratus ribu peso dari hasil penerbitan obligasi yang diizinkan oleh Undang-Undang Republik Nomor 1000 guna membiayai pembangunan kembali dan rehabilitasi cabang Cabanatuan Perusahaan Kereta Api Manila yang membentang dari Kotamadya Plaridel, Provinsi Bulacan ke Kota Cabanatuan
title.ms: Akta mengeluarkan jumlah tiga juta lapan ratus ribu peso daripada hasil isu bon yang dibenarkan oleh Akta Republik Nombor 1000 untuk membiayai pembinaan semula dan pemulihan cawangan Cabanatuan Syarikat Keretapi Manila yang membentang dari Perbandaran Plaridel, Wilayah Bulacan ke Bandaraya Cabanatuan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1290_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Out of the proceeds of the bond issue authorized by Republic Act Numbered One thousand, there is appropriated the sum of three million eight hundred thousand pesos to finance the re-establishment and rehabilitation by the Manila Railroad Company of its Cabanatuan Branch extending from the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Bulacan, to the City of Cabanatuan, within a period of two years from the date of the approval of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1955.
